title: Compactness of a Weighted Composition Operator Generated by the Critical IBDS Transformation
content: We study a weighted composition operator on the Hardy space of the unit disk generated by the critical case of the Implicit Biparametric Deformator System (IBDS). The associated analytic symbol and weight are derived explicitly. The symbol maps the unit disk into itself, and its boundary image is a circle with diameter equal to the unit interval, meeting the unit circle at a unique point. We associate a positive measure with the operator and establish a uniform Carleson-box estimate of order three-halves near the boundary contact point. This estimate implies that the associated measure is a vanishing Carleson measure. Consequently, the weighted composition operator is compact on the Hardy space and has essential norm zero for every admissible value of the deformation parameter. The result illustrates how the boundary geometry and associated weight of the critical IBDS transformation determine the compactness properties of the resulting operator.
